description: JavaScript helper functions for managing pop-up windows and form data exchange in SuiteCRM, including opening popups, setting return data, and constructing initial filters.

methods.name: get_popup_request_data
methods.description: Returns the JSON stringified version of the popup request data stored in the window object.

methods.name: get_close_popup
methods.description: Returns the close_popup object stored in the window document.

methods.name: open_popup
methods.description: Constructs a URL with parameters and opens a new popup window for selecting related records, managing popup count and focus.

methods.name: set_return
methods.description: Populates a form with data returned from a popup, decoding HTML entities.

methods.name: set_return_and_save
methods.description: Populates a form with popup data and submits it to save.

methods.name: set_return_and_save_targetlist
methods.description: Populates multiple forms with popup data, adds hidden inputs if needed, and submits for batch update.

methods.name: get_element_index
methods.description: Finds the index of a form element by name within a specified form.

methods.name: get_initial_filter_by_account
methods.description: Constructs an initial filter string based on account ID and name from a form.
